questions.question: In an equilateral triangle ABC, D is the midpoint of side BC. If the length of BC is 8 cm, then the height of the triangle is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

BC is 8 cm

D is the midpoint of side BC.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ee3c3299d27cd223fb95b2137a4a5c4c94e254dc53302c2902e76861c32f262.png] 

As we know, the median of an equilateral triangle bisects the base and makes 90°So,

So, BD = DC = BC/2 = 4 cm

Now,

AD² + DC² = AC²

⇒ AD2 + 42 = 82

⇒ AD2 + 16 = 64

⇒ AD2 = 64 - 16

⇒ AD2 = 48

⇒ AD = √48

⇒ AD = 4√3

So, height is 4√3 cm

**∴ The required answer is 4√3 cm.**

questions.question: A thief steals a bike at 12:30 p.m. and drives it at 48 km/h. But the theft is discovered after half an hour. The bike owner starts to chase him on another bike at 58 km/h. The thief will be caught at ________.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A thief steals a bike at 12:30 p.m. and drives it at 48 km/h.

The bike owner starts to chase him on another bike at 58 km/h.

**Concept used:**

Time taken to meet = Initial Distance / Relative

Speed Distance = speed × time

**Calculation:**

In 30 min the thief will cover 48 × 1/2

⇒ 24 km

Now,

The owner need to cover up this 24 km to catch the thief

Relative speed = 58 - 48

⇒ 10 km/h

Time = 24/10

⇒ 2.4 hour or 2 hours 24 minutes [As 1 hour = 60 minutes]

So, the thief will be caught at 1 p.m + 2 hour and 24 minutes

⇒ 3:24 p.m

**∴ The thief will be caught at 3:24 p.m.**

questions.question: If Δ ABC~Δ FDE such that AB = 9 cm, AC = 11 cm, DF = 16 cm and DE = 12 cm, then the length of BC is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

AB = 9 cm, AC = 11 cm, DF = 16 cm and DE = 12 cm

**Concept used:**

When two triangles are similar, their corresponding angles are equal and their corresponding sides are proportional.

**Calculation:**

As ΔABC ~ ΔFDE

questions.question: The radii of two cylinders are in the ratio 1 ∶ 4 and their heights are in the ratio 4 ∶ 3. Their volumes will be in the ratio ______.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of radii of two cylinders = 1 : 4

Ratio of height of two cylinders = 4 : 3 

Formula Used:

Volume of cylinder = πr²h [where r = radius of base and h = height]

**Calculation:**

Let the radii of two cylinders be x and 4x and their heights be 4y and 3y

Volume of 1st cylinder : Volume of 2nd cylinder = πx² × 4y : π(4x)² × 3y

⇒ 4x²y : 48x²y

⇒ 1 : 12

**∴ Their volumes will be in the ratio of 1 : 12.**

questions.question: Three circles of radius 6 cm are kept touching each other. The string is tightly tied around these three circles. What is the length of the string?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Three circles of radius 6 cm are kept touching each other.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4975c69029e7a1c7d303fdc50aecc82072a4605039371102d559a105306b89a6.png] 

The length of the string not in contact with the circle = 2r + 2r + 2r

⇒ 6r = 6 × 6

⇒ 36

By symmetry, the angles swiped by the string on one circle is 120.

Length of string touching circle = 2πr/3 + 2πr/3 + 2πr/3

⇒ 6πr/3

⇒ 2πr = 2 × 6 × π

⇒ 12π

Total length = 36 + 12π

**∴ The required answer is 36 + 12**π** cm.**

questions.solution:

Population of Goa in the year 1997 = 39,31,200 × 100/120

⇒ 32,76,000

questions.question: Suman paid Rs.9,600 in interest on a loan she obtained 5 years ago with a simple interest rate of 16%. What was the amount of the loan she had taken?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Suman paid Rs.9,600 in interest on a loan she obtained 5 years ago with a simple interest rate of 16%.

Concept used:

S.I = (P × T × R)/100

P = Sum

T = Time

R = Rate

**Calculation:**

Let the sum be Rs. x

According to the question,

9600 = (x × 16 × 5)/100

⇒ 9600 × 10 = 8x

⇒ x = 96000/8

⇒ x = 12000

So, the sum is Rs. 12000

**∴ The amount of the loan she had taken was Rs. 12,000.**

questions.question: The cost of a piece of diamond varies with the square of its weight. A diamond of Rs. 6,084 value is cut into 3 pieces whose weights are in the ratio 3 ∶ 2 ∶ 1. Find the loss involved in the cutting.
questions.solution:
**Given: **

The ratio of the weight of the pieces is 3 : 2 : 1

The diamond worth Rs. 6,084 is accidentally dropped and broken into 3 pieces.

**Concept used:**

The cost of a piece of diamond varies with the square of its weight.

⇒ Price = k × weight²......(k is any constant)

Let the weight of a piece of the diamond be 3a + 2a + a = 6a

**Calculation: **

The initial value of diamond = 36ka²

According to the question,

36ka² = 6084

Then, The new value of diamond becomes = k (9a² + 4a² + a²) = 14ka²

New value of diamond = (14 × 6084)/36 = Rs. 2366

Loss occurred = 6084 - 2366 = Rs. 3718

**∴ The loss involved in the cutting is Rs. 3,718.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__ **

The initial value of diamond (3 + 2 + 1)2 = 62 = 36 unit

After cut the value becomes (32 + 22 + 12) = 14 unit,

The loss occurred (36 - 14) = 22 unit

So, 36 unit → Rs.6084

Then, 22 unit → 6084/36 × 22 = Rs.3718

questions.question: The marked price of an article is Rs. 10,927. Due festive season, a certain percentage of discount is declared. Raju buys an article at a reduced price and sells it at Rs. 10,927, and makes a profit of 11.5%. What was the percentage discount offered?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The marked price of an article is Rs. 10,927.

**Concept used:**

Selling price = Marked price × (100 - Discount)%

Selling price = Cost price × (100 + profit)%

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

Cost price of Raju × (111.5)/100 = 10927

⇒ Cost price of Raju = 10927 × (100/111.5)

⇒ Cost price of Raju = 9800

Discount = 10927 - 9800

⇒ 1127

Discount% = (1127/10927) × 100

⇒ 10.31 ≈ 10.3%

**∴ The percentage discount offered was 10.3%.**

⇒ (x + y)² = 81

⇒ (x + y)2 = 9²

⇒ (x + y) = 9

questions.question: Vikas covered a certain distance by bike. If he covers 40% of the distance at 40 km/h, 50% of the distance at 25 km/h and the remaining 10% distance at 10 km/h. Find his average speed over the whole distance.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Vikas covers 40% of the distance at 40 km/h, 50% of the distance at 25 km/h and the remaining 10% distance at 10 km/h.

**Concept used:**

Average speed = Total distance/Sum of total speed

**Calculation:**

Let the total distance be 100x

Now,

Average speed = (100x)/(frac{100x times 40\%){40}+(100x ×50\%)/(25)+(100x ×10\%)/(10)}

⇒ (100x)/(frac{40x){40}+(50x)/(25)+(10x)/(10)}

⇒ (100x)/(x + 2x + x)

⇒ (100x)/(4x)

⇒ 25 km/h

**∴ His average speed over the whole distance was 25 km/h.**
